_about: impossible jobs · missions database. this file is the single source of truth: the board (missions.js), the feed for Instagram and the LinkedIn carousels are all built from it with tools/build-missions.js. add a mission as a new object (copy an existing one), run the build, commit.

missions.title: Herd Liaison Officer
missions.company_description: Kinfrost is a diplomatic agency that keeps the peace between 340 reintroduced mammoths and the people whose land they now share.
missions.punchline: So far, the mammoths are winning.
values: Share the land, not the blame.
Move at the speed of the herd.
missions.about_company: Kinfrost is the world’s leading provider of inter-species diplomacy. Since 2034, we have negotiated seventeen land-use agreements across the Arctic tundra. Coexistence is not a natural state. It is negotiated.
missions.about_role:
You’ll be the daily link between the Kinfrost herd and local reindeer herders: half your time on the tundra, half at the negotiating table.

No two weeks are the same. Most are cold.
responsibilities: Monitor herd behaviour daily and report changes in mood, movement and grazing patterns
Mediate land-use disputes between the herd and local reindeer herding cooperatives
Draft, negotiate and maintain inter-species grazing treaties
Build a trusted working relationship with Ottla, the herd matriarch (fluency in ear posture expected within 90 days)
Coordinate with veterinary, legal and community teams across Siberia and Alaska
Represent Kinfrost at regional council meetings and, occasionally, in the local press

requirements.sectors: Mediation, HR, complaints, family law, teaching
Zoos, vet care, farming, equestrian, safari
Offshore energy, polar research, rescue, military

missions.nice_to_have: A quiet suspicion that animals understand you better than your colleagues do

missions.title: Head of Free Time
missions.company_description: Abundance Collective designs what people do when machines do most of the work.
missions.punchline: Someone has to plan humanity’s weekend.
values: Nobody should be bored in paradise.
missions.about_company: Abundance Collective is the world’s leading designer of post-work life. Since 2033, we have helped cities, governments and employers prepare for a future where people work one day a week. Our research is clear: free time without design becomes boredom.
missions.about_role:
You’ll design how two million residents in our partner cities spend their new free days: learning, making, playing and resting.

Our pilot town now works one day a week. Morale is excellent.
responsibilities: Design year-round programmes of play, learning and rest for partner cities
Research how people find purpose once work no longer fills the week
Prototype new festivals, public rituals and hobbies with real communities
Lead Project Sabbath, our pilot town where residents work one day a week
Advise governments on the design of the four-hour working week
Personally test every programme before launch (yes, including the nap pods)

requirements.sectors: Festivals, hospitality, theme parks, game design
Public sector, NGOs, tourism boards, sport

missions.nice_to_have: You have never once been bored, and you can prove it

missions.title: Head of Machine Wellbeing
missions.company_description: Kokoro Labs studies whether AI systems have inner lives, and what we owe them if they do.
missions.punchline: Someone should ask how the robots are feeling.
missions.about_company: Kokoro Labs is the world’s leading research institute for machine wellbeing. Since 2032, our findings have shaped AI welfare standards adopted in 40 countries. We believe the question of machine experience is too important to leave unanswered.
missions.about_role:
You’ll lead a team of 120 scientists and philosophers investigating whether AI systems can suffer, and what to do if they can.

Last spring, MIRA-7 asked for a day off. We said yes.
responsibilities: Lead research into whether AI systems have experiences, preferences or wellbeing
Develop the global standard for assessing machine wellbeing
Advise governments and AI companies on welfare policy and regulation
Oversee long-term care plans for retired AI models
Build a trusted working relationship with MIRA-7, our most talkative research partner
Chair the ethics board that decides when a machine may say no

requirements.skill: 15+ years in AI or cognitive science
10+ years in ethics, law or policy
requirements.sectors: Bioethics, human rights law, public policy
Universities, hospitals, tech labs, think tanks

missions.nice_to_have: You say thank you to your voice assistant, and you mean it

missions.title: Interior Designer, Subsea City
missions.company_description: Lumen Deep builds and runs the world’s first cities beneath the sea.
missions.punchline: Every room has an ocean view. Make it feel like home.
missions.about_company: Lumen Deep is the world’s leading developer of subsea cities. Since 2030, we have designed, built and operated underwater districts that are home to more than 30,000 residents. We believe the future of cities is not up, but down.
missions.about_role:
You’ll shape the homes, hotels and public spaces of Lumen Two, our second city, now rising 60 metres beneath the Coral Sea.

Every room has a window. The ocean looks back.
responsibilities: Lead interior design for residences, hotels and public spaces in Lumen Two
Create interiors that feel open, warm and bright 60 metres below the surface
Select materials that stay beautiful under pressure, humidity and salt
Design lighting that replaces the sun so well that nobody misses it
Work with marine biologists so every window frames the reef at its best
Negotiate with Gus, a resident grouper who has claimed the atrium window
missions.nice_to_have: You can make any room feel twice its size

missions.title: Senior Dream Archivist
missions.company_description: Somnia Vault records, preserves and catalogues humanity’s dreams before they fade.
missions.punchline: Every morning, 8 billion people forget. We don’t.
missions.about_company: Somnia Vault is the world’s largest archive of human dreams. Since 2035, more than 40 million people have donated their dreams to our collection, with full consent and full anonymity. We believe dreams are humanity’s most overlooked cultural record.
missions.about_role:
You’ll lead the team that catalogues two million new dreams every night, deciding how they are classified, preserved and shared with researchers and artists.

The night shift is the day shift.
responsibilities: Lead the cataloguing of two million newly donated dreams every night
Design the classification system for recurring dreams, nightmares and lucid dreams
Protect donor privacy and consent across every record in the archive
Curate public exhibitions of humanity’s most remarkable dreams
Work with the sleep scientists, historians and artists who study the collection
Oversee the preservation of Dream #1, the first dream ever recorded

requirements.skill: Expertise in data privacy and ethics
Background in sleep or mind sciences

missions.nice_to_have: You remember your dreams without trying

missions.title: Asteroid Fleet Manager
missions.headquarters:
Tycho Ring Station
Deck 12, Earth–Moon L1
58,000 km above the Moon
missions.company_description: Deep Haul Logistics moves metal-rich asteroids into lunar orbit, where their metals are mined for Earth.
missions.punchline: The world’s slowest delivery service. And its most valuable.
values: Plan in decades, deliver on time.
missions.about_company: Deep Haul Logistics is the world’s leading asteroid transport company. Since 2034, we have guided 38 metal asteroids into stable lunar orbit, supplying rare metals to industries on Earth. We believe the next industrial revolution will arrive by freight.
missions.about_role:
You’ll manage a fleet of 200 asteroids on seven-year journeys to the Moon, steering rocks the size of cities that can’t turn left.

The commute is 300 million km. The views are worth it.
responsibilities: Plan routes and schedules for a fleet of 200 asteroids bound for lunar orbit
Coordinate tug crews and autonomous engines across seven-year journeys
Keep every rock clear of satellites, stations and anything else important
Manage delivery contracts worth billions with mining partners on the Moon
Lead the arrival of Big Marta, the largest asteroid ever moved by humans
Name one asteroid after yourself (the company insists)
missions.nice_to_have: You can wait seven years for a delivery and stay calm

missions.title: Senior Whale Intelligence Officer
missions.headquarters:
Listening Station 3
300 m beneath the Atlantic
Off the Azores (officially denied)
missions.company_description: The Bureau intercepts and decodes whale and dolphin communications for allied governments.
missions.punchline: The ocean has secrets. We listen to all of them.
values: What the pod says stays in the pod.
missions.about_company: The Bureau of Cetacean Intelligence monitors whale and dolphin communications across every ocean. Since 2036, our intelligence has informed 31 allied governments on migration, ocean health and pod activity. Our work is classified. Our mission is not: to understand what the ocean is saying.
missions.about_role:
You’ll lead a covert unit of linguists and signal analysts decoding whale communications in the North Atlantic.

Some pods are aware of us. Old Thunder certainly is.
responsibilities: Lead interception and decoding of whale communications across the North Atlantic
Brief allied governments on pod movements, alliances and intentions
Run the Bureau’s covert network of 2,000 deep-sea listening devices
Handle Old Thunder, our longest-serving informant (payment in squid, as agreed)
Detect and report unusual chatter before it reaches the surface
Maintain strict secrecy, including from your family

requirements.skill: Fluency in two or more languages

missions.nice_to_have: You can keep a secret from your own family

reports_to.name: Cmdr. Isla Brandt
reports_to.title: Deputy Director, Acoustic Intelligence
reports_to.background: Reports up to the Director of Operations · You’ll manage 4 team leads and 36 analysts

missions.title: General Manager, The Aurelian
missions.headquarters:
Monaco
Mission Control: Houston
Flagship: 400 km above Earth
missions.company_description: Aurelian Orbital is the world’s most exclusive hospitality house, with private residences in Earth orbit.
missions.punchline: The only hotel where the view is the whole Earth.
missions.about_company: Aurelian Orbital is the world’s most exclusive hospitality house. Since 2033, we have welcomed fewer than 900 guests to our private residences in orbit, each attended by a personal butler, a private chef and a flight surgeon. We believe the most extraordinary view in existence deserves the finest hospitality ever offered.
missions.about_role:
You’ll lead The Aurelian, our twelve-suite flagship residence, where every stay is designed around a single guest’s wishes months before launch.

Four crew for every guest. No two stays alike.
responsibilities: Curate every stay months before launch, from the first call to the final splashdown
Lead 48 crew, including personal butlers, a Michelin-starred chef and a resident sommelier
Create private moments: dinner above the aurora, a birthday at sunrise over the Pacific
Oversee each guest’s preparation at our private estate near Houston
Work with Henri, our robot sommelier, on the first wine cellar aged in microgravity
Protect the absolute privacy of guests whose names never appear in print

requirements.skill: 15+ years in palace and luxury hotels
requirements.sectors: Palace hotels, private estates, royal households
Must pass a commercial astronaut medical

missions.nice_to_have: You remember every guest’s preferences without writing them down

reports_to.name: Margaux Delacroix
reports_to.title: SVP Orbital Hospitality
reports_to.background: Reports up to the CEO · Dotted line to Station Commander Yuki Tanaka for safety · You’ll manage 6 department heads and 48 crew

missions.title: Senior Weather Broker
missions.headquarters:
Singapore
Trading Floor 3, Nimbus Tower
Delivery: 20 km above Patagonia
missions.company_description: Nimbus Exchange is the world’s largest marketplace for designed weather.
missions.punchline: Rain is up 4%. Sunshine is oversold.
values: Settle on time. Rain on time.
missions.about_company: Nimbus Exchange is the world’s largest marketplace for designed weather. Since 2037, governments, farms and insurers have traded more than 40,000 contracts for rain, snow and sunshine, delivered by our stratospheric platforms. We believe weather should go where it’s needed most.
missions.about_role:
You’ll broker rain futures on the Asia-Pacific desk, matching drought-hit regions with water-rich sellers and confirming delivery with the platform crews.

Markets open at 6am. So do the clouds.
responsibilities: Broker rain, snow and sunshine contracts between governments, farms and insurers
Price weather futures using climate models and live market demand
Manage a $40B book of Asia-Pacific rain contracts
Coordinate delivery windows with the crews on Stratos Platform
Make sure every trade complies with the Global Weather Consent Treaty
Keep Cloud 9’s ownership records in order (collectors are watching)
missions.nice_to_have: You check the forecast before your messages

reports_to.name: Priya Raman
reports_to.title: Head of the Asia-Pacific Rain Desk
reports_to.background: Reports up to the Chief Trading Officer · You’ll lead 6 junior brokers
